newsitem.title: USA: CBOT rice ends down as U.S. at premium to Asia.
newsitem.headline: CBOT rice ends down as U.S. at premium to Asia.

text.p: CBOT rice futures closed lower despite a firm tone overseas with the steep premium the U.S. market holds to Asia cited as a key pressuring factor, traders said.
"Although the Thai market was up overnight the U.S. market still is at a $125.00 per tonne premium to the Thai," a trader said.
The rice futures market remains rangebound with local selling driving the market into light sell stops, they said.
Rice futures volume was estimated at 500 contracts, above the 245 contracts traded Tuesday, according to the CBOT.
Rice closed five to eight cents per cwt lower, with January down 7-1/2 at $10.60-1/2.
